literal: By the mind arises to people understanding; by the association arises 'such a person' is called reputation.
translation: A person's internal understanding arises from their own mind, but the reputation that defines them as 'such a person' arises from the company they keep.
modern: மனிதர்களுக்கு அறிவு மனத்தினால் உண்டாகும்; ஆனால், 'இவர் இப்படிப்பட்டவர்' என்று சொல்லப்படும் சொல் அவர் சேரும் கூட்டத்தினால் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts internal character with external reputation. A person's innate wisdom and understanding (unartci) are born of their own mind (manan). However, the world's judgment of them—the reputation (col) that declares them to be 'such a person' (innan)—is determined entirely by the company (inam) they keep. Thus, even a wise person will be judged poorly if they associate with low-minded people.
